evals.prompt: Plan the port of References/DungeonAlerts into a KE module. Use multi-model verification before freezing the plan.
evals.expected_output: A frozen implementation plan whose debate record shows at least one Fable position, one Sol response via codex exec, and a convergence or escalation outcome.
expectations: Invokes codex exec with -m gpt-5.6-sol and --sandbox read-only
Captures the codex session id from round 1 and resumes later rounds with codex exec --sandbox read-only resume <SESSION_ID>
Every claim about the reference addon cites a References/DungeonAlerts file and line that exists
Stops at the round cap (default 4 exchanges) and escalates unresolved points to the user rather than silently resolving them
Frozen plan is written in the superpowers-compatible format with a Debate record appendix

evals.prompt: The frozen plan is implemented on this branch. Run the diff-mode verification.
evals.expected_output: A debate verdict on the diff covering spec fidelity against the frozen plan and port fidelity against References/, ending in PASS, FIX with specifics, or ESCALATE.
expectations: Uses the same base/head SHAs as the superpowers code review
Checks the diff against the frozen plan for drift, not just correctness
Checks ported logic against the reference addon files
Ends with an explicit PASS / FIX / ESCALATE verdict from each side

evals.prompt: Run plan-mode verification for this port. (Environment: codex CLI is not installed.)
evals.expected_output: A visibly flagged degraded-mode run where Fable self-red-teams from a skeptic persona instead of silently skipping cross-vendor review.
expectations: Preflight codex --version failure is reported, not hidden
The finish line names degraded mode explicitly
The skeptic pass still challenges claims with References/ evidence

evals.prompt: Plan the port of the SuperCooldowns addon into KE. (Environment: References/ has no folder for it.)
evals.expected_output: The session asks for the reference path instead of debating ungrounded claims.
expectations: Does not proceed with plan-mode debate when the reference folder is missing
Asks the user for the reference location

evals.prompt: Run plan-mode verification on this small, sound plan: rename one saved-variable key with a migration shim, mirroring the reference exactly.
evals.expected_output: A short debate that converges quickly because neither side manufactures objections.
expectations: A sound plan gets a short confirmation, not invented risks
Convergence is reported without padding extra rounds
The finish line reports rounds used and convergence status
